messages.author: 041f4347d6c4723f
messages.subject: highlight style for jss
parts:
Hi everybody. I’m writing an article for Journal Statistical Software. Is there an highlight style for that journal? The closest style I found is greyscale0, but it’s still different.

Thanks for the help.

Best,

Alessio

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] highlight style for jss
parts:
I used syntax highlighting once in a JSS submission, and the editors
said it was not allowed. You might try again, but I guess you are
likely to fail again like me. If you use knitr for JSS articles, the
only "correct" thing to do is to use the Sweave style, which can be
obtained via knitr::render_sweave() in the first code chunk, e.g.

<<setup, include=FALSE>>=
knitr::render_sweave()
@

Regards,
Yihui
